notes.title: Dev Log: Thank You
notes.content:
Thank you.
After launching Nobody Wants to Die two weeks ago, we are beyond grateful to see so many of you taking on the case. Seeing the city of New York 2329 through your own eyes and giving everyone the full experience of complete and utter immersion was truly important to us.   

So, we handed the dossier to you to be the first to uncover clues and the stories they hold. We made this game for you and are thrilled our community were able to be some of the first to play and dive into the moral dilemmas of eternal life with no bias or preconceptions. 

The response from you – the players – has been incredible, especially with this being our very first game as Critical Hit Games. We are reading your comments, seeing your reactions, and watching you make the story into your own – and loving every second of it. While creating our vision of a dystopian New York City was enormously exciting, watching you all experience it has been truly remarkable.  


More than half a million trailer views 
We’re pleased to share that the Nobody Wants to Die launch trailer has been watched more than half a million times. Thank you to everyone who shared, liked, or watched the trailer. As an indie team, we really appreciate it. 

Watch the launch trailer here:
[previewyoutube=m7qjR1S5njU;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for playing and sharing your stories with us, we can’t wait to see more. 

- Critical Hit Games

notes.title: Dev Log | Music
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922101/58c1321b6fcc5e006b68ae8c2a30ad168260c187.jpg

With launch nearing, we’re excited to discuss one of the most important aspects of Nobody Wants to Die – the soundtrack.

Music
As a narrative-driven game, music plays a very important role in setting the scene and fulfilling the immersive experience that we wanted to produce with Nobody Wants to Die. 

Music is essential in helping us shape the emotions players feel throughout the course of the game – setting the rhythm and atmosphere for New York, 2329. 

With the music being such a crucial aspect of the game, we knew we could only trust award-winning composer, Mikolai Stroinski, with such a task. His previous work on titles including; The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, League of Legends, Age of Empires, made him the natural choice in creating the sound of a dystopian New York noir story. 

Imbued with a sense of dark intrigue, the soundtrack’s melodic and moody theme encapsulates the noir essence of the game, putting players into the shoes of Detective James Karra. 


Soundtrack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922101/a51cb4c670898463b87ceeeed736e9ce17c5ade7.png
The Nobody Wants to Die Soundtrack will be available to purchase from launch as part of a bundle with the game, exclusively on Steam.  

Two tracks from the soundtrack are available to preview on Mikolai Stroinski’s Soundcloud, including: 


 Nobody Wants to Die
 Neon Wants A Drink


It has been an honour to work with Mikolai to create an incredible soundtrack for Nobody Wants to Die. We can't wait for you to experience it yourself soon.  

- Critical Hit Games

notes.title: Dev Log | World Building
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After revealing a look at the gameplay for Nobody Wants to Die, we have been overwhelmed with the response and support we have received. As a small team from Wrocław, Poland, we could never have expected such a huge response.  

With one month until you enter this world, we invite you to take a look into the creation process and explore the world of Nobody Wants to Die – beginning with some early concept art and insight into the story we have weaved. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922101/0d52c0ac7b57e912fb233c5fee025febfb5b0897.jpg

Nobody Wants to Die is an interactive noir story set in a dystopian New York City, where you’ll play as Detective James Karra investigating crime scenes to uncover the mysteries of the city’s elite. 

We wanted to create a thought-provoking narrative for players by only making only one metaphysical change to the current world we live in – the possibility of consciousness transfer. This change alone changes everything. It pulls into question our current values, way of thinking, way of living, and the rules of Western civilization – in such a way that perfectly creates a dark vision of the future. 

We hope to inspire players to think about contemporary values, the rules of the world, and what is important in life – there are even some in-game choices and conflicts connected to that for players to tackle with. 

New York, 2329
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922101/767bdb1a7637eb11499eca6699c21e8b79e52766.jpg
Admiring from above, you let your legs dangle off the ledge of a towering skyscraper. You watch the neon signs and billboards flicker and illuminate an otherwise dark city.

New York is one of the hearts of contemporary utilisation. We wanted Nobody Wants to Die to say something about the contemporary culture of the Western world, making New York City the prime location for the narrative to unfold. Our futuristic vision was a huge metropolis that would spread and grow in every direction. 

James Karra’s Apartment
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922101/5f1f4196177a83a686628f49e0f2e2f8daaee5de.jpg
You arrive back at your apartment – it's not much, but it’s a place to think. You realise you left a window cracked as you hear the faint whir of traffic outside. The city that never sleeps, makes damn sure that you won’t either as the apartment glows under the city’s harsh neon signs. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922101/ba2296e6efb8d41343756d77986ea8a9422791e7.jpg
Throughout the game you will retreat into the confines of James’ apartment, where you will piece together the evidence and analyse clues to draw out the truth. 

James, a 120-year-old jaded cop, and Sara, fresh to the force in her late 20s, are our two protagonists in this narrative. They contrast each other with different motivations and goals becoming apparent throughout the narrative. By playing as James, you’ll get to know your investigation partner Sara to be an especially multifaceted character with secrets and motivations of her own that you’ll unravel as you move through your investigation. 


We are excited to share more about the game as we approach July 17 and look forward to welcoming you to New York, 2329 soon. 

- Critical Hit Games

After four years of dedication and hard work from our small team here in Wrocław, Poland, we're excited to reveal the Nobody Wants to Die narrative-driven gameplay for the first time, as well as confirm when you will get to experience our vision of the future. 

Gameplay Trailer
Step beyond your human shell into the world of New York, 2329 with this first glimpse at Nobody Wants to Die’s gameplay.

Click to watch the trailer:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922101/36c3c8680e02593eb1518b954c6aeb9f49090d98.jpg

Become immersed in this interactive story as you dive deep into crime scenes with your investigation tools. 

Analyse blood splatter patterns using your UV lamp, use your hand-held x-ray to peek beneath the surface, and hone your time manipulation techniques – to uncover the evidence and reveal the truth.

Release Date
Lose yourself in Nobody Wants to Die’s sci-fi world on July 17th, 2024, on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam.

notes.title: Welcome to Nobody Wants to Die
notes.content:
We are Critical Hit Games, an independent studio of seasoned game developers based in Wrocław, Poland. Last week, our inaugural project, Nobody Wants to Die, was revealed to the world in partnership with IGN to an overwhelming result.

We’re excited to share that we have reached more than 1.4 million views on our announce trailer for Nobody Wants to Die! Watch the trailer below if you haven't already.

Nobody Wants to Die | Cinematic Announce Trailer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922101/3900a8870fa05141ce05e1e345ae477b86b484b7.jpg
 
Nobody Wants to Die is an innovative experience taking place in futuristic New York City, inspired by neo-noir films, offering a distinctly visual aesthetic and intriguing plot. Playing as Detective James Karra you investigate crime scenes using time manipulation and advanced technology to uncover clues and unmask a killer in an era where death is a thing of the past. 
  
Utilising the power of Unreal Engine 5, we have pushed the boundaries of storytelling, combining realistic cinema graphics and a distinctly unique narrative experience to deliver a non-stop, immersive story to lose yourself in later this year.
